licence.attribution: もみじ (Momiji). Words: 高野辰之 (1947). Music: 岡野貞一 (1941). First published 1911, 尋常小学唱歌（二）. Public domain in Japan and the United States.

japan.basis: lyricist 高野辰之 (1947); composer 岡野貞一 (1941). The later of the two deaths is 1947.
japan.test: Japan: both authors died 1967 or earlier, or the work is anonymous and published 1967 or earlier.

us.test: US: published 1930 or earlier, or published later with every author dead in 1945 or earlier, because the URAA restored anything still protected in its source country on 1996-01-01.

_licence.verses_permitted_note: The report transcribes the first verse only, so this file carries one verse. More verses need a fresh trip to the source, not a memory.

Verdicts, credits and the authors' death years are copied from that file.

items.line: あきの ゆうひに てる やま もみじ

gloss.en: Mountain leaves glowing in the autumn evening sun; among all the deep and pale shades, the maple and ivy colouring the pines are a patterned hem at the foot of the hill.
